issues.detail: The Greek 'ποου το σωμα εκει συναχθησονται οι αετοι' translates to 'where the bodies will be gathered there, the eagles [will be]'. The Vietnamese translation 'Xác chết ở đâu, chim ưng sẽ nhóm lại tại đó' (Where are the corpses, the eagles will gather there) slightly alters the structure and implies a question/answer format ('ở đâu') that isn't explicitly structured as a separate question in the Greek clause.

The Vietnamese omits the specific nuance of 'συναχθησονται' (will be gathered/assembled) by simply saying 'nhóm lại' (gather), though this is a minor stylistic point. However, the primary issue is the structural shift in the 'where' clause.
